description: I7-IV7-V7-bVII7 shout library in all 12 keys, dominant-7 voicings, chromatic bass walks, organ-run variations, and 8 ever-changing loop patterns mapped to Sanctum's 8x16 pad grid (MIDI 36-51 per bank; globalPad = bankIndex*16 + padIndex). Theory and patterns only — no audio.

theoryNotes.romanAccidentals: Relative to the major scale of the tonic (same as src/pulpit/theory.ts).
theoryNotes.bassRegister: theory.ts bassNote(ch, 28) — notes sit 28-39; bassMidiOct is +12 when the line should stay high (e.g. Gb2=42 after Eb2=39)

midiPadMap.convention: MPC: note 36 = bank pad 1 (bottom-left), note 51 = pad 16 (top-right). In-bank notes 36-51 map to pads 0-15. globalPad = bankIndex*16 + padIndex (0..15). NoteEvent.p is 0..127. Sending 36-51 while Bank C is selected hits organ pads; the same notes while Bank E is selected hit percussion.

banks.note: Performance launchers for the 8 shout loops plus intensity / modulate / variation.
Existing church-bank guitar loops/stabs (G/C/D/A). Sample keys follow keyTempoMap: G=132, C=120, D=140, A=150.
Theory pads resolve in the session key (all 12). The shipped shout-organ bank is sample-based in G/C/D/A only — Lawrence to decide MIDI-rendered organ vs sample pads.
Pads 1-8 are theory walks (all 12 keys). Pads 9-16 overlay the shipped G/C/D/A bass samples.
Roles include kick/snare for the trigger engine. The shipped shout-percussion bank is tamb/shaker/claps — no kick/snare. Kick/snare may come from Foundation or a future kit; Lawrence to assign.
Live MIDI chord triggers in the session key. Tritone of V7 is bII7 (in Ab: Eb7 -> A7).
Pads 1-8 are theory runs (all 12 keys). Pads 9-16 overlay shipped G/C/D/A organ loops and swells.
Suggested overlay: stage-fx-modern. Open question — 9 shipped banks vs 8 pad banks A-H.

relativeMinor.name: Dbm
relativeMinor.spellingNote: KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Dbm; conventional sharp-side name is C#m.

relativeMinor.name: Ebm
relativeMinor.spellingNote: KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Ebm; conventional sharp-side name is D#m.

relativeMinor.name: Abm
relativeMinor.spellingNote: KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Abm; conventional sharp-side name is G#m.

organ-open.label: 7open
organ-open.description: Open organ 7: root-5-b7-10 (3rd up an octave)

bassWalkConvention.description: Degree numbers are of the current MAJOR key (I=1 ... VII=7). Accidentals (#2, #4, b7) are chromatic alterations of those degrees. A walk named chrom-to-N LANDS on scale degree N (the last step is the target root). MIDI examples use bass floor 28 (E1), same algorithm as theory.ts bassNote(ch, 28). In Ab: 1=Ab 2=Bb #2=B 3=C 4=Db #4=D 5=Eb 6=F b7=Gb 7=G.
bassWalkConvention.noteOnStub: A 1-2-#2-3 walk (C D D#/Eb E in C, MIDI [36,38,39,40]) approaches degree 3, the leading tone into IV — it does NOT walk into V. Walk INTO V in Ab (target Eb) is 3-4-#4-5 = C Db D Eb = [36,37,38,39]. An alternate 4-note approach from further below (2-#2-3-4 = Bb B C Db) arrives at Db and lands on Eb on the following downbeat.

bassWalks.description: 3-note chromatic walkup that lands on scale degree 5 (the V root). Degrees 3-4-#4-5. In Ab (into Eb): C Db D Eb.
bassWalks.grid: 8th-or-16th pickup into the V downbeat; last step is the V root

bassWalks.description: 3-note chromatic walkup that lands on scale degree 4 (the IV root). Degrees 2-#2-3-4. In Ab (into Db): Bb B C Db. Pickup-only variant 1-2-#2-3 (Ab Bb B C / C D D# E) leads to 4 but does not include it.
bassWalks.grid: 8th-or-16th pickup into the IV downbeat; last step is the IV root

pickupOnlyVariant.note: Matches the common C2 figure [36,38,39,40]. Next downbeat is degree 4.

bassWalks.description: Shout bass octave pops: root on the beat, octave above on the off-beat.
Dense shout bass: sounded roots on the 8ths, low-velocity ghost neighbors (degree 2 or b7) on the 16ths.
Pedal the tonic. Breakdowns and talking-preacher holds sit on degree 1.

organRuns.description: One-bar descending Mixolydian run from the tonic (8 eighths).
One-bar blues-scale fill (root pentatonic plus #4). Generic vocabulary, not a quoted lick.
Short chromatic gliss into the next downbeat (one octave).
Short call-and-response organ-talk stabs: I7 on the upbeat, IV7 answers on the next upbeat.

patterns.name: Call & Response
patterns.form: 2 bars call on I7, 2 bars response on IV7, twice — second half changes voicing and adds organ talk stabs on upbeats

resolvedPreview.note: Bars 1-4 (var A) vs bars 5-8 (var B): same I7<->IV7 call/answer, different voicings and bass — not a copy-paste loop.

patterns.name: Shout Build
patterns.form: Bars 1-4: one chord per bar. Bars 5-8: two chords per bar (harmonic rhythm doubles). Chromatic walk 3-4-#4-5 into every V.

resolvedPreview.note: Harmonic rhythm 1/bar then 2/bar; voicings thicken in the second half so bar 5 is not a repeat of bar 1.

patterns.name: Full Praise Break
patterns.form: Full I7-IV7-V7-bVII7 vamp. Dense 8th-note bass with ghosts. Organ run every 4 bars (mixo-down then blues-fill).

resolvedPreview.note: In Ab: I7=Ab7, IV7=Db7, V7=Eb7, bVII7=Gb7. Relative minor = Fm. Tritone of V7 (Eb7) = A7. Walk into V: C Db D Eb (MIDI 36 37 38 39). Bars 1-4 vs 5-8 swap voicings (close 7 -> 9/13/7#9) and organ runs so the loop never reprints a bar.

patterns.name: Breakdown
patterns.form: Bars 1-4: I7 pedal, hats only, one sparse IV7 hit. Bars 5-8: snare returns, more IV7, still lean.

resolvedPreview.note: Texture change (hats-only -> snare return) plus a voicing change keeps bars 1 and 5 from matching.

patterns.name: Storefront
patterns.form: I7-bVII7-IV7-I7 storefront vamp. Second/backbeat snare (pad E3) in front; handclaps on upbeats (pad E4).

resolvedPreview.note: In Bb: I7=Bb7, bVII7=Ab7, IV7=Eb7. Storefront feel is the backbeat snare + upbeat claps.

patterns.name: Walk Home
patterns.form: 4-bar turnaround played twice (bars 1-4 / 5-8) with different voicings: I7 | I7/3 | IV7 | #ivdim7 | I/5 | V7 | I7. In Ab: Ab7 - Ab7/C - Db7 - Ddim7 - Ab/Eb - Eb7 - Ab7. Bass walks chromatically Ab-Bb-B-C into the /3, then Db-D-Eb into I/5 and V.

resolvedPreview.note: Chromatic bass spine in Ab: 32 (Ab) -> 34 35 36 (Bb B C) -> 37 (Db) -> 38 (D) -> 39 (Eb) -> 32/44 (Ab).

variationA.name: Ab7/C
variationA.bassWalkNote: 1-2-#2-3 into the 3rd in the bass (Ab Bb B C = 32 34 35 36)

patterns.name: Truck-Driver Modulate Up
patterns.form: Same I7-IV7-V7-bVII7 vamp; transpose up a half step every 8 bars (truck-driver).

modulation.note: After 12 lifts the vamp returns to Ab. Operators usually take 2-4 lifts at a peak, then settle or break down.

resolvedPreview.note: Variation A = first 8 bars in Ab (Ab7 Db7 Eb7 Gb7). Variation B = next 8 bars in A (A7 D7 E7 G7). Not the same loop twice.

patterns.name: Relative Flip
patterns.form: Bars 1-4 in major I7-IV7-V7-bVII7 (Ab7 Db7 Eb7 Gb7). Bars 5-8 in the relative minor i7-iv7-bVI7-bVII7 (Fm7 Bbm7 Db7 Eb7). Flip rebuilds by returning to major.

resolvedPreview.note: Major side is the shout vamp; minor side is darker (breakdown color) and shares Db7/Eb7 with the major IV/V, so the flip is a mode change more than a new set of roots.

antiRepetition.how: On each re-trigger or each new 4-bar window the engine picks a voicing, bass walk, and (every 4 or 8 bars) an organ run from variationRules, weighted, skipping any choice that would reprint the previous bar's (token, voicing, bassWalk, organRun) tuple. Mid-loop modulate uses the listed options without stopping the groove: relativeMinor flips mode, upHalf/upWhole are truck-driver lifts, circleFifth moves to the key a fifth up.

intensityMap.description: Sanctum intensity 1-5 puts harmonic substance under the Whoop-style shout/worship detents (their shout side is 4 levels; we use 5 so breakdown has its own floor).

3.name: Build
3.chordDensity: full I-IV-V-bVII, rhythm doubling or turnaround

5.name: Full break / peak
5.rhythmicDensity: full kit, organ runs every 4 bars

call-and-response.label: Call and response
call-and-response.description: Leader/congregation or preacher/band back-and-forth. Light clap, organ stabs on upbeats, I7 answering IV7.

build.label: Build
build.description: Density rises: harmonic rhythm doubles, chromatic walk into V, or the walk-home turnaround that dumps into a shout.

shout.label: Shout / praise break
shout.description: Full vamp, storefront backbeat + upbeat claps, or truck-driver half-step lifts at the peak.

breakdown.label: Breakdown (and rebuild)
breakdown.description: Strip to an I7 pedal and hats, or flip into the relative minor, then bring snare / major vamp back.
